query: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi
name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text:
This was our 2nd visit to Rixos Saadiyat, first was November 2024. We really enjoyed our first stay so much that we came back.  Was really nice that some of the staff recognised us and the service was excellent from all throughout our stay.

Some nice upgrades to the loungers at the pool and the cooler boxes are a great idea.

Nice addition to the DJ set up at the beach bar with the mirrored setting.  The vibe created at the beach bar is amazing getting really chilled for sunset; however the music set could be changed daily as it gets repetitive,  sounds more like a preset playlist rather than a proper DJ set.

Evening entertainment is in a great setting in the outdoor area,  well organised and the vibe is very chilled,  however the bands playing this year were all virtually identical with all playing the same songs,  it began to get repetitive.

Buffet provided ample choice and had something for everyone.

We dined at Aja, Orient, Mermaid and L'Olivio and all were excellent,  food was delicious and really good choice on the menus. Staff service at all was first class.

Highlights pool bar was excellent, thanks to all the guys who knew exactly what we were drinking and kept us topped up all day, special mention to KB for introducing us to a particular rum cocktail.

Bar lounge was excellent with a great selection of drinks and great staff constantly on the go ensuring we were taken care of.

Overall great stay,  we highly recommend 👌
owner_answer:
Dear Mr. Mark James,

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent experience at Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island. We are delighted to learn that you returned for a second visit and that our staff made a positive impression by recognizing you. It is gratifying to hear that you enjoyed the upgrades to our amenities and the atmosphere created at the beach bar.

We appreciate your input on the music selection at the beach bar and the evening entertainment. Your comments regarding the repetitiveness of the playlists and performances will be taken into consideration as we continuously strive to enhance our guest experiences. We are pleased that you found the buffet and the dining options at Aja, Orient, Mermaid, and L'Olivio to be excellent, as well as the service provided by our dedicated staff.

Thank you for your generous recommendation. We hope to welcome you back for another wonderful stay in the future.

Best regards,
Guest Relations Team

review_text:
Очень приятный отель. Прекрасный, доброжелательный и крайне внимательный персонал. На территории и в номерах очень чисто. Чудесное постельное белье. Еда выше всяких похвал, на любой вкус .
Мы просили за месяц до прибывания, чтобы нам сделали номера рядом и на первом этаже , за меся это вполне возможно организовать. Однако, оказалось, что эта информация не дошла до отеля и ресепшен. Но сотрудники нам помогли и сделали номер на первом этаже, рядом не получилось, мои друзья жили выше….
Это было немного странно, что информацию никто не передал и выглядело , просто как игнорирование просьбы , за фразой «мы сделаем всё, что возможно» .  Но сотрудники ресепшен Любовь, всё исправила.
То что люди , которые выезжают из отеля позже 12 дня , не могут пойти на обед, выглядит, как то странно, про том количестве еды , что остается .
Нас это тоже не коснулось. Но для других, я полагаю это важно и может испортить впечатление об отдыхе.
Мы вернемся на следующий год ещё большей компанией .
Спасибо.

review_text: This hotel is a dream come true! The infrastructure is dreamy, very well designed. The gardens, the pools are kept very clean and the care of the facility is great! Every staff, from the receptionists, waiting staff, pool managers, the cleaning staff, everyone not only very attentive but so kind and greets with a hearty smile. And if you are thinking of spending your baby moon here or the first vacation with your baby (doesn’t matter if 1 month or older): it is the perfect place to spend your holiday! Not only is it baby friendly, we were provided with much care and support from everyone. We were provided with a baby bottle sterilizer, a cod (but you can cosleep since there is no gap in the bed and the beds are big enough), they even have strollers to lend out. If you have bigger kids there is a babysitting service (if I’m not mistaken from 1 year old onwards) and a kids club with a baby/ kids pool. We also recommend getting massages (special thanks to Oxana who is a wonderful massage therapist). The spa has won many awards and we agree that it deserves them. The spa is separated for men and women. To add on: everyone here tries wishes to come true, any request you have there will be at least someone trying their best to make it possible. Even if you arrive late at night, try to talk to the front desk about your possibilities, there are many more things (whisky tastings, sports club, etc.). There is a small market to get diapers, things for babies, even baby sunglasses, you could arrive with no luggage and you would find everything here. The food is another level: the selection is massive. Nobody will leave hungry. And it’s very fresh. Special thanks to the very friendly bakers! The next ATM is 5 min away by walking. Thank you Rixos! See you next year! Special thanks to Yasin, Eren, Erdem, Nathalia, Manuela, Ludi, Angelyn, Ianne, and many more people.

review_text:
Прожили 10 дней в Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — как раз в пик сезона, во время Гран-при Формулы-1. Выбор отеля оказался удачным: несмотря на высокую загрузку, всё работало слаженно и без сбоев.

Питание — одно из главных достоинств. Особенно впечатлили морепродукты: !краб!, устрицы, мидии, разные виды рыбы — подавали регулярно и с разной подачей, так что интерес не угасал даже к концу отпуска. Шведский стол действительно богатый — столы буквально «ломятся» от блюд, в том числе и с местными, и с интернациональными акцентами. Десерты - отдельная история, самый Чизкейк на всем белом свете. В мясном ресторане а-ля карт очень приятный официант София)

Пляжная зона — отдельное удовольствие. Песок мелкий, белоснежный, ухоженный — ни ракушек, ни камней. Вход в море очень плавный, вода прозрачная и чистая. На каждом лежаке есть кнопка вызова официанта, персонал очень оперативно приносит коктейль, свежайшие фрукты и снеки.

В целом, Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island — это отель для тех, кто ценит спокойствие, качественное питание и продуманный сервис без излишней театральности. За 10 дней ни разу не захотелось «сбежать» куда-то — всё, что нужно для настоящего отдыха, было под рукой.

query: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi
name: Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island
review_text:
My partner and I stayed for 8 nights in November for the first time. I’ll start with the positives we experienced during our stay.
Firstly the location is perfect, you are equally close to Yas Island or the city and can enjoy exploring both, you’re also very close to the new cultural district which has museums to explore. The beach is stunning along with the sunsets you can view.
Next the service, every staff member there is incredibly kind and helpful, from the pool to each restaurant, they can’t do enough to help.
Finally the common areas are stunning, the decor is extravagant and clearly a lot of thought has been put into it.

Now onto the negatives, if you are not a family this is not the hotel for you. It is a predominantly family friendly hotel with only one main pool.
There is a huge kids pool with slides and a wave pool that was empty during our stay, we were told by staff that this was because alcohol is not served in these areas so the parents prefer the main pool. An easy fix would be to change this rule or something more permanent would be to build an Adults only pool. There were some areas of sun loungers that were adult only but they were not poolside and they also had children there with staff not enforcing the rule.
Onto the food, we were really disappointed in the quality of food at the resort, even in the al a carte restaurants, it was fine but not in standing with the cost of the stay. The drinks on offer were generally really good, except the wine, of which there were only two option of both red and white - both of which weren’t great.
The rooms themselves looked tired, I don’t think there has been any work done to maintain the standard since opening and it showed. Paint peeling and chipped, and general wear and tear on the furniture. We stayed in the fourth floor overlooking the pool in a sea view room, at multiple points during our stay there was a smell of sewage in the hallway. One evening we returned to our room  and the smell was incredibly strong inside, I called reception immediately to report it, they called back after 20 minutes to offer us a new room on the ground floor, but at this point is was 11pm and we were tired. My parents were staying two doors down and had the same issue and the same solution was offered however again not appropriate at the time, after a while the smell started to dissipate so we were able to get to sleep. The following day management followed up with my mum (not me) and offered the same room again, however we had selected the sea view rooms for exactly that so it wasn’t an appropriate compensation, they also offered my parents a discount upon their next stay.
I work in hospitality and this was shocking to me, you should not have to pay extra in order to solve a solution that has happened during this stay. The hotel could have easily offered a complimentary gesture such as resort credit and it would have been a welcomed, particularly given the cost of the stay.
Upon checkout nothing was mentioned to me at all, no apology or acknowledgment of the issue, so I asked to speak with a Manager. I explained the problem and advised how I was really disappointed with the communication and management of the whole issue, she had no idea about it and also no idea who had been communicating with my parents, but reassured me she would fix it as they had two more days left of their stay.
Unfortunately no one reached out to them at all, and upon checking out they were informed that a ‘free’ bottle of prosecco had been placed in their room - this was incorrect, so potentially was left in the wrong room - and again this is the same prosecco that is complimentary across the resort so no real effort.
It was an incredibly disappointing end to a mostly positive stay at the Rixos, I would encourage some Incident resolution training for their management along with taking the above feedback on board.

name: Shangri-La Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We stayed here for 7 days, and it was the first holiday in a long time where I didn't want to go back home.

The hotel was phenomenal, both in staff and amenities. My previous experience in the UAE was Jumeriah Al Qasr Dubai, and this was even better. Lovely pools, amazing private beach, and wonderful interiors.

The staff were extremely helpful and attentive throughout our stay, going out of their way especially for our 1-year-old daughter. On one occasion a cleaner passed us in the hallway, asked for our room number, and then returned 10 minutes later with a toy for our baby. Such thoughtfulness means a lot when travelling with a family. Special mention to doorman Siju who helped us out repeatedly with our pram and car seat.

Food wise, I was absolutely blown away by the daily buffet. I am not normally a fan of this, but I have NEVER been to a buffet of such consistently high quality and variety. Unfortunately, I did eat too much and now need to diet. There was too much food to try and all of it was excellent.

This was such a great trip for our family, and my daughter also learned to walk in the long carpeted corridors outside the rooms.

In terms of location, it's ideally situated with a Souk on one side and a pier full of restaurants (and the aquarium) on the other. It's also a short Careem/Uber ride to the malls, which were also brilliant. There is a gym next to the Souk which does the job for anyone looking to burn some calories (machines for every body part, a smith machine, a trap bar, and some heavyish dumbells).

I will certainly be returning - much calmer than Dubai and far fewer influencers.

Thank you for an unforgettable stay.

Die Hotelanlage verfügt über eine eigene kleine shopping mall und einen Supermarkt, zu dem man auf Wunsch auch mit dem club car gefahren wird.
Für jedes Anliegen hatten die Rezeptionisten/innen ein offenes Ohr.
Besonders von der lieben Service Kraft Aashi waren wir sehr begeistert. Als Abschiedsgeschenk gab es sogar noch ein kleines Dessert mit der Aufschrift “see you soon”. Wir haben uns durch und durch wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.

Das Personal war zu jeder Zeit hilfsbereit und freundlich😀 der Zimmerservice mit Shramal muss besonders erwähnt werden. Nachdem wir vom Restaurant Sofra bld so begeistert waren, haben wir jeden Abend dort gegessen. Verschiedene Themenabende und auch orientalische Gerichte haben uns begeistert. Ich habe noch nie ein Nachtischbufett erlebt, wo wirklich alles eine Köstlichkeit ist. review_text:
Das St. Regis Saadiyat Island ist ein herausragendes Resort, das besonders für Familien keine Wünsche offen lässt. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in vollen Zügen genossen und können die vielen positiven Online-Stimmen nur bestätigen.
Service & Personal
Die Mitarbeiter sind extrem höflich und sympathisch; man wird überall mit einem ehrlichen Lächeln begrüßt. Besonders hervorzuheben ist der 24/7 Butler-Service. Dass man den Concierge jederzeit kontaktieren kann, sorgt für ein echtes "Rundum-sorglos-Paket". Im Restaurant wird Gastfreundschaft großgeschrieben: Die Mitarbeiter merken sich individuelle Vorlieben, was den Service sehr persönlich macht.
Kulinarik (Ein Paradies für Langschläfer)
Ein absolutes Highlight ist das Frühstück bis 13:00 Uhr – optimal für alle, die gerne ausschlafen und trotzdem Wert auf ein hochwertiges Buffet legen. Sowohl das Frühstück als auch das Abendbuffet bieten eine super Auswahl und erstklassige Qualität.
Anlage & Umgebung
Die Anlage ist riesig und geht direkt in den Residence-Bereich über. Das ist extrem praktisch, da man in nur wenigen Schritten ein Einkaufszentrum, Friseure, Beautysalons und Cafés erreicht. Trotz der Größe ist das Resort makellos sauber – die Einrichtung (auch in den Zimmern) ist formidabel, wir konnten buchstäblich kein Staubkörnchen finden.
Strand & Natur
Der Strand ist wunderschön; wir sind jeden Tag bis zum Sonnenuntergang geblieben. Besonders bemerkenswert und lobenswert ist das Engagement des Resorts für die Umwelt: Der Schutz der Nestplätze für gefährdete Schildkröten zeigt, dass hier Luxus und Naturschutz Hand in Hand gehen.

Their professionalism and kindness created an atmosphere where we felt cared for at every single moment.

There were so many individuals who made our trip memorable, but a heartfelt thank you goes especially to Ohsen, Obi, Dibyajyoti (Panda), Manisha,  Chef Ajay and Chef Mukesh,

Each of them went above and beyond in ways we didn’t expect, delivering thoughtful touches and personal gestures that transformed a great holiday into an extraordinary one.

We cannot recommend the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort highly enough. If you're looking for luxury, serenity, and service that truly sets a new benchmark, this is the place. We’re already counting down the days until our next visit!

review_text:
The Bridge wellness hub is an excellent place to exercise and relax. As I am new to the country and the city of Abu Dhabi, I searched through the city to find a nice place to engage with local community, and also improve my health conditions. It turns out that The Bridge is the place that you can do both!

On the same day Mr Hamza gave a tour to myself and my partner, we decided that this is the place to be. The following months proved us right. If you would like to have a tour of the place, please make sure to ask for Mr Hamza, he will guide you through all the facilities, packages, and take care of you for all the aftermaths. I truly appreciate his help!

Well, Mr Hamza is not the only one you can rely on, Mr Lan from the Krave restaurant on the ground floor has consistently shown his hospitality every time I visit the restaurant. The services with the valet parking, the SPA facilities, and the reception, are all exceptional. At the end of the workout, I could choose to relax in the sauna, or have a walk along the creek in the Al Qana complex. If anyone knows any other place can beat this experience? Please let me know, because so far this is the best place in Abu Dhabi I could find.

As comfortable as I already am, there are still other facilities I have not used often, such as the rooftop pool, group classes, and community activities. I am sure they will not disappoint. My partner is super hyped about the puppy yoga event and marked in her agenda long before the event itself.

All in all, I could wholeheartedly recommend this place. A well-deserved 5-star!

Thank you so muchfor taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. We are truly delighted to know that THE BRIDGE has become a welcoming place for you to both connect with the community and take care of your wellbeing here in Abu Dhabi.

We’re very happy to hear your kind words about Hamza and Lan, we will be sure to pass along your appreciation to them and the rest of the team. It’s wonderful to know you enjoyed our facilities, hospitality, and overall experience, and we can’t wait for you to explore even more of what we offer, from rooftop pool time to group classes and our community events.

We are grateful for your trust and recommendation, and we look forward to continuing to support you and your partner on your wellness journey.

Regards,
THE BRIDGE Team

query: The Bridge Al Qana Abu Dhabi
name: THE BRIDGE | Wellness Hub
review_text:
I couldn’t believe I’d ever write a bad review about The Bridge. I’ve been a member for almost 3 years, and my fitness journey started here. I used to love this gym — it felt like home. But now, I’m honestly heartbroken and extremely disappointed. The Bridge has changed — and not in a good way.

Let’s start with the ladies’ gym: it’s still the same tiny studio, with barely any equipment. We have one Smith machine, one shoulder machine, two back machines, and that’s it. The heaviest plate is only 15kg. I’ve requested so many times — for a leg press, hip thrust machine, abductor, back machines, and more plates. Not once did I get a reply. Every time I ask who to talk to, I’m told “Admissions doesn’t want to change anything.” So who’s actually listening to the members?

They recently added a new cardio studio, but it’s on the other side of the gym on the same floor, separated by just some curtains. It’s a very small area with maybe 4 cardio machines and 2 stair masters. That’s not enough for the number of women using the gym, and it doesn’t fix the bigger issue — the lack of proper weight training equipment.

Then there’s the ladies-only timing — from 9 AM to 12 PM on weekdays. Most of us work during those hours, and for the few who can go, it’s still not enough time. I’ve raised this point before too, and once again, nothing changes.

What frustrates me most is the renewal process. They used to offer small discounts for loyal members. This year, I got nothing — just a higher price, and now I’m paying more than double what I originally paid. And for what? The ladies’ section hasn’t improved at all. It feels like we’re being overcharged and ignored. How can prices keep going up, but the services stay the same — or worse?

I miss the old Bridge. The coaches back then were amazing — they knew us by name, brought energy to every class, and made the gym feel like a real community. Now, most of them are gone. Some of the new coaches have no energy, don’t engage with the class, and just go through the motions. Even the staff and security have changed, and it’s just not the same vibe anymore.

The Bridge keeps changing, but not for the better. All we ask for is a well-equipped ladies’ gym, proper communication, and coaches who care. I never thought I’d say this, but the gym that once felt like my second home now just feels like a business that stopped caring.

review_text:
Das Wahat Al Karama Monument ist den Märtyrern der vereinigten Arabischen Emirate gewidmet, und ehrt die Taten der Kriegshelden, die ihr Leben für das Wohlergehen der Bürger der vereinigten Arabischen Emirate opferten. Das kostenlos zugängliche Monument, ist nachts beleuchtet, und ein Superfoto Spot für die große Moschee, die sich direkt gegenüber befindet.

Benötigte Besuchszeit : für die Besichtigung des Monuments, und die ebenfalls auf dem Gelände befindliche Kunstausstellung, sollten Besucher 30-45 Minuten einplanen.

Anreise: es gibt eine Fußgängerbrücke, die von der großen Moschee direkt rüber zu dem Monument führt, wodurch das Wahat Al Karama Monument einfach zu Fuß erreicht werden kann. Es stehen jedoch auch ausreichend kostenlose Parkplätze zur Verfügung, und für die Anreise mit dem öffentlichen Nahverkehr, gibt es eine Bushaltestelle, die sich ebenfalls direkt vor dem Monument befindet.

Shuttle Bus: es gibt einen Shuttle Bus, der im 30 Minuten Takt zwischen dem Wahat Al Karama Monument, und der großen Moschee hin und her fährt.

Eintritt: Das Wahat Al Karama Monument ist 24/7 kostenlos zugänglich, und Barriere frei!

name: واحة الكرامة
review_text:
Of course. Here is an extremely positive review for Wahat Al Karama, written specifically for photographers.

★★★★★

The Ultimate Reflection Shot of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque!

For photographers, Wahat Al Karama isn't just a beautiful memorial; it is the single best and most essential location in Abu Dhabi for capturing an iconic, postcard-perfect shot of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

The key is the massive, shallow reflection pool that forms the centerpiece of the memorial. It is a perfectly designed, giant liquid mirror. By positioning yourself at the far end of the pool, you can achieve a breathtaking, symmetrical reflection of the entire mosque, including all its domes and minarets.

The best time to shoot is unquestionably sunset. Arrive about an hour before sunset to secure your spot. You'll be able to capture the mosque during the golden hour as the warm light hits its white marble, then witness the sky explode with color, and finally, stay for the magical blue hour as the mosque's own lights turn on, creating a dazzling display in both the sky and the water.

Bring a tripod, a wide-angle lens, and some patience. The shot you will walk away with is absolutely world-class and worth the visit alone. A must-do for any serious cityscape or travel photographer visiting Abu Dhabi.

F1 - Fideles Night
First of all, the venue is clearly not prepared for techno nights.
The lighting and sound system are extremely disappointing — far below what you would expect from a club under the White brand. The quality is genuinely shocking for such a name.

Prices are unreasonable. Paying AED 185 for a single vodka Red Bull is ridiculous and doesn’t match the experience provided.

On top of that, parking was AED 50 even though I already had a ticket for Fideles.
If I’m attending an event and already paying to use the facility, charging separately for parking makes no sense — it feels like another way to squeeze guests.

Overall, the value for money is absolutely not there.
White Abu Dhabi needs serious improvement before hosting techno events again.

review_text:
White Club Abu Dhabi — Extremely Disappointing Experience

My wife (52) and I (54) attended the “Old School Jam” event on 05 December 2025 and spent approximately four hours at the venue. We were initially welcomed very well, and the atmosphere at entry was pleasant.

However, this positive first impression was completely overshadowed by what followed. Over the course of the evening, we each had a few drinks — certainly no more than 10 per person. When we requested our bill upon leaving, we were shocked to be presented with a total of AED 2,000. Even more concerning, no itemized receipt was provided despite asking for one.

Without a transparent breakdown of charges, it is impossible to verify what we were actually billed for. This lack of billing transparency is unacceptable and left us feeling extremely uncomfortable and taken advantage of.

Unfortunately, this experience has completely eroded our trust in this establishment. We will not be returning and would strongly advise others to exercise caution and always insist on itemized billing before settling payment.

name: WHITE Abu Dhabi
review_text:
⸻

Very disappointed with White Club in Abu Dhabi.
Today my friends and I had an extremely unpleasant experience. We ordered specific drinks, but they brought us something completely different and, what is even more outrageous, charged us double the price for it! When we immediately said that we did not order those drinks, the waiter was incredibly rude, spoke to us arrogantly, and made no attempt to fix the issue.

The service is absolutely not what you would expect from a place that positions itself as high-end. Instead of apologizing and correcting the mistake, the staff acted as if we were at fault for placing an order at all. The atmosphere, which was supposed to be enjoyable, turned into a stressful experience — our evening was completely ruined.

I have been to many venues in Abu Dhabi, and I have never encountered such treatment towards customers. It is unacceptable to charge for something we did not order and then show such disrespect.

I do not recommend this club to anyone who values honesty, respectful service, and a pleasant experience. There are plenty of other places in the city where you can enjoy your time without this kind of negativity. White Club in Abu Dhabi is definitely not worth the money or attention.
🥲🥲🥲🤦🏻‍♀️
owner_answer:
We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience and sincerely regret that your evening at White Club Abu Dhabi did not meet your expectations. What you described falls far below the standard of service we aim to provide, and we understand how frustrating and disappointing this must have been.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text: I have to explain why I’m giving this excellent place a 4 star: expectation vs price and comparison to Zuma Dubai. The Dubai branch was above and beyond and really deserving of 5 stars despite the expense. Here they fell short on multiple front. The tables were squeezed so tightly that navigating between them was an issue. The service while excellent but was too rushed. The appetizers were on the table in less than 5 min and the mains came in 10-15 min after. The miso soup was average. The shrimp tempura was very good but could be better. Nigiri was excellent but at this price range it is not compelling. The highlight of our meal was the sweet potato ice cream with pecan which was to die for. Would I come again or recommend? definitely yes after all I’m nitpicking because at this level I was expecting more.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Zuma today and it honestly couldn’t have been a better experience. From the moment we sat down, the service and hospitality stood out just as much as the food and drinks.

A special shout-out to Kamal, our main server. He struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. He checked on us at just the right times, always had an eye on our table without hovering, and even refolded our napkins every time we left the table – those small details that really make you feel looked after. He was warm, easy to talk to, asked if we were new to Zuma and the brunch, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout.

We also had the pleasure of being looked after by Apollo, the sommelier. He was incredibly patient, humble and kind, with a calm, warm presence that makes you want to sit and chat with him about wine all afternoon. His recommendations were spot on, and you can tell he truly enjoys what he does. He explained the wines in a simple, friendly way and was very accommodating to our preferences. Just a great person to have guiding us through the wine list.

Another special mention to Dominique. He wasn’t even serving our table, but he was one of the only team members walking past who noticed the “Happy Anniversary” message on our dessert plate and acknowledged it. As people from the hospitality industry ourselves, we really appreciate those tiny touches of awareness and genuine guest care. That simple moment of recognition says a lot about him and about Zuma’s culture. He has a spark of personality that will definitely take him a long way and adds to the Zuma brand.

The food was outstanding – we left absolutely stuffed. The quality of the produce, especially the seafood and the raw dishes, really sets Zuma apart from other high-end places. You can taste the intention and care behind every plate. The wines were excellent, and even the coffee smelled and tasted amazing.

Overall, an incredible anniversary brunch. Huge thanks to Kamal, Apollo, Dominique and the rest of the Zuma team for making our day so special. 🌟🍷🍣 Highly recommended.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma never misses. Whether it’s lunch or dinner, the experience is top-tier from start to finish. I’ve been here more times than I can count and it’s consistently excellent, food, service, vibe, all on point.

The business lunch is one of the best deals in Abu Dhabi, generous portions, great variety, and perfectly executed dishes. You walk out full, satisfied, and still on schedule. For dinner, it’s a whole other level, dim lighting, smooth music, and that signature Zuma buzz that somehow makes even Tuesday feel like a Friday.

Favorites? Always the spicy beef tenderloin, black cod, sushi platter, and that dangerously good green tea banana cake. Cocktails? Sophisticated without trying too hard. Service? Polished, but human.

If I had one suggestion, maybe a couple more rotating seasonal specials or AD-exclusive dishes could keep things extra fresh for regulars like me. But honestly? Still five stars. Zuma is a benchmark for what dining in Abu Dhabi should feel like.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I have been dining at Zuma Abu Dhabi for over 11 years, and I have never experienced something this alarming. Today, I found a strange soft, purplish object in my salad  much larger than what was later shown to me and it was breaking apart when touched. The moment I saw it, I felt immediate stomach discomfort and a strong urge to vomit.
For a fine dining restaurant of this level, this is extremely unacceptable. The team told me they would “investigate,” but this should not happen in a place known for hosting high-profile guests and operating in a country with strict health and safety standards.
I am truly disappointed, and I hope the management takes this matter seriously. This experience was shocking and far from what I expect from Zuma.

We took a chance visiting Zuma on Sunday for lunch with our two kids, and the experience was truly five-star. While the reputation focuses on high-end cuisine, the atmosphere was perfectly welcoming for a family meal.
The food was, without question, excellent. The quality of the sushi and signature dishes is arguably the best in Abu Dhabi. Every single plate was executed flawlessly, arriving quickly and beautifully presented.
The service, however, truly elevates the experience. It was great: attentive but never intrusive. A special shoutout goes to Ana, our server, who made the entire lunch completely stress-free and ensured the children felt just as welcome as the adults.
Zuma proved that fine dining and family fun can absolutely coexist. We highly recommend it for a special weekend lunch.

review_text: 12 out of 10. The food was top-notch. Every meal we ordered was crafted in a uniquely “Zuma” way. Even something as simple as the soy beans (Edamame) was elevated beautifully. The request for a medium cook on our Wagyu was spot-on. The wine selection was amazing. The look and feel of Zuma is and always has been one of my favorites. What pushed this visit above excellence was the service. Ana Maria was amazing. Attentive, knowledgeable, and just amazing to talk to. Then there was Apollo. He went above and beyond in getting our wine to the preferred temperature. His recommendation of the Nanakanba Umeshu (Plum wine) was a definite winner! And a huge thank you to Daniel. He was amazing as the manager. I will 110% be returning. For anyone considering visiting, I highly recommend Zuma Abu Dhabi.

name: Zuma Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Zuma Abu Dhabi is absolutely amazing! Every time I visit, the experience is perfect from start to finish. The restaurant has a beautiful modern design with a warm and elegant atmosphere — perfect lighting, great music, and a lively vibe that makes it feel special the moment you walk in.

The food is incredible. Every dish is prepared with so much care and flavor — the sushi, black cod, and wagyu beef are on another level. The presentation is beautiful, and you can really taste the quality of every ingredient. Even the desserts are a work of art — the Zuma chocolate fondant is a must-try!

The staff are very professional, polite, and attentive without being too much. They always make sure everything is just right. The outdoor terrace is also stunning, especially during sunset with the beautiful Abu Dhabi skyline in view.

Yes, it’s a premium restaurant, but honestly worth every dirham for the quality, service, and atmosphere you get.

If you’re looking for the best dining experience in Abu Dhabi, I highly recommend Zuma — elegant, delicious, and unforgettable every single time.
